# Bishnu Bhusal

> Bishnu Bhusal is a computer science researcher working on differential privacy, formal verification, and privacy-preserving machine learning and LLMs. Publications at ACM CCS, AAAI, and OOPSLA.

## Research and writing

- [Research topics](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/research/): Reading paths through differential privacy, language models, formal verification, and security.
- [All publications](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/): Publication records, full author lists, abstracts, papers, code, and citations.
- [Research tutorials](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/blog/): Technical explanations with links to the original research.

## Differential privacy and formal verification

- [Deciding Differential Privacy of Online Algorithms with Multiple Variables](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/chadha2023ccs/): Conference paper, 2023. Extends DiP automata to online randomized algorithms with multiple real-valued storage variables. The paper characterizes when an automaton is Dε-differentially private for some D and every ε > 0, proves that deciding this property is PSPACE-complete, and implements an algorithm that also computes a suitable D.
- [Approximate Algorithms for Verifying Differential Privacy with Gaussian Distributions](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/bhusal2025ccs/): Conference paper, 2025. Introduces DipApprox for verifying differential privacy of loop-free probabilistic programs that use Gaussian and other discrete or continuous distributions. It combines numerical integration and tail bounds to approximate probabilities to arbitrary precision, with an almost-decidability result for (ε, δ)-privacy: all but a finite set of δ values are decidable under the paper's assumptions.
- [Checking δ-Satisfiability of Reals with Integrals](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/rivera2025oopsla/): Journal article, 2025. Extends δ-decision procedures over the reals to constraints containing integrals of user-specified functions. The ∫dReal implementation builds on dReal and is evaluated on fairness, privacy, utility, and parameter-synthesis problems.
- [DiPAut: A Tool for Checking Differential Privacy of Online Randomized Algorithms](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/bhusal2023dipaut/): Software release, 2023. Provides the DiPAut software artifact for checking differential privacy of online randomized algorithms, with a versioned Zenodo record and a public implementation repository.

## Privacy-preserving language models

- [Privacy Preserving In-Context-Learning Framework for Large Language Models](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/bhusal2026aaai/): Conference paper, 2026. Presents a differentially private prediction framework that generates synthetic text by aggregating clipped per-token logits from inference over private records, without fine-tuning the underlying language model. A blending operation combines private and public inference to improve utility in the evaluated in-context-learning tasks.
- [Inner Momentum for Differentially Private Muon](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/bhusal2026dpmuon/): Preprint, 2026. Studies how unequal per-example clipping factors can distort the singular-vector geometry used by Muon. The proposed inner-momentum method averages each sampled example's gradients across the current and recent models before clipping. The preprint gives a distortion analysis and reports improved BLEU and ROUGE-L over DP-Muon in seed-matched private GPT-2 fine-tuning on E2E and DART at ε ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8}.

## Security and privacy in practice

- [On Countering Ransomware Attacks Using Strategic Deception](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/neupane2024gamesec/): Conference paper, 2024. Models ransomware defense as a multistage game with honeytokens, honeypots, honeyfiles, and network honeypots. The paper uses backward induction to analyze subgame-perfect Nash equilibria and evaluates the defender's choices through a numerical healthcare case study informed by real-world data and statistics.
- [Privacy Nutrition Labels: Promise, Practice, and Paradoxes in Communicating Privacy](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/bhusal2025hcii/): Conference paper, 2025. Reviews privacy nutrition label research from 2009 to 2024 using qualitative coding of 78 papers. The study maps the communities, goals, and methods represented in the literature, identifies gaps, and provides a dataset with qualitative codes for further analysis.
- [Formal Verification for Blockchain-based Insurance Claims Processing](https://bishnubhusal.com.np/publications/neupane2024noms/): Conference paper, 2024. Models blockchain-based insurance claims processing and checks the underlying chaincodes using linear temporal logic and model checking. The modeled stages include issuing claims, approving or denying them, and flagging claims for fraud investigation.
